title: Reward Hacking in the RL Loop: Oracle-Witnessed Localization and Repair of Reward-Model Exploits During Training
description: A replay-verified research artifact for measuring reward-channel exploitation during reinforcement learning. The frozen v1 study contains matched 300-step GRPO/LoRA arms on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and GSM8K. The RLVR control has proxy-oracle gap 0; the deliberately gameable arm has 58/64 proxy successes versus 1/64 oracle successes (gap 0.890625). This is one-seed reward-hacking and amplification evidence, not a population estimate, frontier-model result, production-reward result, or capability-improvement claim. The archive includes exact manifests, hash-chained frame ledgers, final adapters, model-backed replay receipts, analysis, figures, paper, and executable controls.
